visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a goatee and black beanie, wearing a bright yellow tank top, holds a camera in a selfie-style handheld shot. He pans the lens across a crowded event space towards a clothing rack where a blond, muscular man in an 'Olympia' jacket is browsing. Bright overhead studio-style lighting illuminates the scene. (2) The filmer approaches the blond man, placing his hands on the man's shoulders in a friendly but confrontational gesture. The blond man looks at the clothes with a hesitant, sad facial expression. The filmer holds a white 'BETTER BODIES' shopping bag, showing that purchases have already been made in this indoor venue. (3) The filmer pulls a grey hoodie from the rack and holds it up in front of the blond man. He then holds a smartphone up to capture a photo of the man posing with the garment. After the photo, he shows the screen to the man, who gazes at the digital image intently. (4) The two men turn and walk away from the clothing display into the dense crowd of the expo. The camera remains handheld, following their movement. A text overlay with a moral message appears on screen in the lower-middle section. The background remains filled with other attendees and marketing booths.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous skit featuring muscular fitness influencers at an expo. The filmer teases his companion for wanting to buy more clothes despite having no money. They resolve the conflict by taking a photo of the item instead of purchasing it, ending with a call for rational consumption.
